usageNotes: Use this to retrieve historical storage performance graphs (returned as a PNG file path) for a specific storage pool on a node. Requires either Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on the /storage/{storage} path. The response contains a filename pointing to the generated PNG — not the image bytes directly — so the caller must fetch that file separately if the image is needed.

examples.summary: Fetch a daily average disk usage graph for the local-zfs storage on pve1

tips: Common datasources for storage RRD include 'used' and 'total' — check the storage's rrddata endpoint to discover what datasources are available for a given pool.
Use cf=MAX instead of AVERAGE to surface peak usage spikes that averages would mask.
The returned filename is a server-side path to the PNG; it is not returned as base64 or a URL — use a subsequent file fetch if you need the image bytes.
This endpoint is read-only and safe to poll frequently for dashboarding; it does not modify any state.
